Schedule

Two weeks to build, one to judge

Building starts on Friday 16 October and submissions close on Saturday 31 October at 11:59 pm IST. The final scores and winners land the week after.

  1. Fri 16 Oct

    Challenge announced. Registration opens and building starts.

  2. Sat 31 Oct, 11:59 pm IST

    Submissions close.

  3. Wed 4 Nov

    Judges' scores and comments published on the leaderboard.

  4. Thu 5 Nov

    Last day to raise a question about a score.

  5. Fri 6 Nov

    Winners announced and prize money sent.

Registration stays open until submissions close, so you can join late.

Register and you will not have to watch this page. Every checkpoint goes out by email to everyone on the list.
